applicantVariants.label: Under 21 (GDL: special learner's or examination permit)

retake.waitBetweenAttempts: Must reschedule; typically at least the next available day
retake.retakeFee: Retest fee applies for the knowledge test

gdl.permitMinAge: 16 (special learner's permit, with approved driver ed) / 17 (examination permit)
gdl.supervisedHoursRequired: 50 hours (permit holders under 21, permit issued on/after Feb 1, 2025)
gdl.nightCurfew: No driving 11:01 p.m.-5 a.m. (GDL permit and probationary drivers)
gdl.passengerLimits: One passenger, unless accompanied by a parent/guardian or the passengers are the driver's dependents

requiredDocuments: Proof of identity and age meeting the MVC 6 Points of ID standard
Social Security Number (or proof of ineligibility)
Proof of New Jersey residential address
process.realIdNotes: New Jersey issues both REAL ID and Standard licenses. REAL ID requires documents that satisfy the 6 Points of ID plus proof of Social Security Number and address; needed to board domestic flights after the federal deadline.
process.visionStandard: 20/50 or better in at least one eye, with or without corrective lenses

facts.pointSuspensionThreshold: 12 or more points results in license suspension
facts.moveOverRule: Move over one lane or slow down for stopped emergency, tow, and highway maintenance vehicles displaying flashing lights
facts.interstateMaxSpeed: 65 mph (where posted, including the Turnpike and Garden State Parkway)

references.label: First driver license and fees
references.citation: NJ MVC - Get your first driver license
